title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Item Attributes
summary: A blog series covering item attributes in Business Central, including how to display them on pages, add factboxes to ledger entries and sales orders, bulk edit attributes, define attributes for variants, and filter by attributes.
key_points: Index of the author's articles on item attributes, published between 2020 and 2026.
Covers showing item attributes on the Item List page and adding the Item Attributes Factbox (page 9110) to the Item Ledger Entries page.
One article examines adding the factbox to the Sales Order page (42) and concludes it is possible with caveats.
Other articles cover a customization for bulk editing attributes across many items and adding a filter by item attributes to Item Ledger Entries.
Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) allows defining item attributes for item variants.
